title: 2018 AT&T DIRECTV RC73 Remote - Brand New - Sealed With Omni Batteries
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:Remote Controls
descriptionText: The 2018 AT&T DIRECTV RC73 Remote is a brand new, sealed remote control specifically designed for DirecTV receivers. It features a wireless range of 5-10 meters and comes with Omni batteries included. This remote is compatible with various DirecTV models and is a convenient accessory for controlling your TV viewing experience from a distance. With its user-friendly design and reliable brand reputation, the AT&T DIRECTV RC73 Remote offers a seamless and efficient way to navigate your TV programming.
